title: Petition by the Department, on its own motion, for a rulemaking procedure to revise and amend certain regulations, set forth in 220 C.M.R. 155 et seq., for the inspection of passenger vehicles for hire, and for the certification of drivers of passenger vehicles for hire, and to revoke regulations set forth in 220 C.M.R. 155.03 pertaining to sightseeing in and from the City of Boston, pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159, and G.L. c. 159A Appendix.
